title: 37th Bangkok Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Bangkok Marathon Review: Midnight Start, Weather, Finish Times
meta_description: Bangkok Marathon review from the 16 November 2025 race: a midnight start by the Grand Palace, 25°C at the gun, 955 marathon finishers and a 4:52 median.
dek: What the 36th Bangkok Marathon on 16 November 2025 was like: the midnight start beside the Grand Palace, the race-night weather, how long the field took, and what has changed for the January 2027 race.
verdict: Enter if you want Bangkok's long-running city marathon, first held in 1987 and run through the night from beside the Grand Palace, and you can cope with a start just after midnight. The November 2025 race had 955 marathon finishers, 2,932 in the half and 3,412 in the 10 km, and it was a kind night by Bangkok standards: 25°C with a dew point of 18°C at Don Mueang when the marathon set off, far drier than the year before. Half the marathon field finished inside 4:52, almost 26 minutes quicker than in 2024, and one in seven took more than six hours. The catch is information: the organiser publishes little about the course, aid or cut-offs, and the 2026 race was postponed to 10 January 2027, so check the details before you book.

sections.heading: The Course: A Night Loop From the Grand Palace
paragraphs: The Bangkok Marathon starts and finishes on Sanam Chai Road, in front of the Grand Palace and the Ministry of Defence [4]. It has a long history: the first race, in 1987, crossed the Rama IX Bridge to mark the king's 60th birthday, and the course passes many of the old city's historic landmarks [6]. The organiser calls it a historical route through Bangkok but posts no route map on its main page [1].

The course is sanctioned by AIMS and the Amateur Athletic Association of Thailand [6]. In 2025 the 10 km set off at 4.30am from Sanam Chai Road [5], and the marathon starts hours earlier, so almost all of it is run in the dark.

Do not confuse it with the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok, a separate race two weeks later. In 2025 that one was held on 30 November, with its marathon and half starting at 2am from MBK Centre on Phaya Thai Road [7].

sections.heading: The Weather: A Dry Night in 2025, a Sticky One in 2024
paragraphs: Don Mueang airport, about 20 km north of the start, recorded 25°C at 12.30am on race night, with a dew point of 18°C, 65% humidity and a 3-knot wind [8]. It cooled through the night to 23°C and 78% humidity from 5am to 6.30am, and was still only 26°C at 8am [8]. For a tropical city that is about as good as race night gets.

It is not guaranteed. On the same night a year earlier, 17 November 2024, the airport recorded 28°C and a dew point of 23°C at 12.30am, and by 4am the dew point had reached 25°C with 84% humidity [9]. The difference shows in the results: the 2025 marathon median was almost 26 minutes faster than in 2024 [10][11]. Look at the forecast dew point in race week, not just the temperature, and set your pace from it.

sections.heading: Aid Stations and Cut-offs
paragraphs: No cut-off times or aid-station plan are posted on the organiser's pages. The 2027 schedule has the marathon starting at 12.30am and the event closing at 8am, seven and a half hours later [1].
In practice the field finished well inside that. In 2025 the slowest marathon finisher took 6:32:33, the slowest half marathoner 4:00:53 and the slowest 10 km runner 2:27:22 [10].

sections.heading: Getting It Right on the Course
paragraphs: The race has had measurement problems in the past. In 2013 street protests forced a late change that cut the half marathon to 19.7 km, and in 2015 a wrong turn left the half far longer than it should have been [6]. Nothing similar has been reported for 2025, but with little published course information, it pays to know the route before you start rather than relying on marshals in the dark.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The 2025 marathon had 955 finishers, almost exactly the 951 of 2024 and up from 861 in 2023, but less than half the 2,014 of 2022 [10][11]. The top ten ran between 2:21:35 and 2:43:34. The fastest woman ran 2:43:34 and the tenth woman 3:26:40 [10].

Behind them the field is slow. The median marathoner finished in 4:52:14, 18.7% broke four hours, 55.5% broke five, and 90% were home inside 6:12:15. About one finisher in seven (15.4%) took more than six hours [10]. In 2024 the median was 5:17:55 and 22.5% took more than six hours [11].

The half marathon grew from 2,538 finishers in 2024 to 2,932, a rise of 16%, and its median fell from 2:34:32 to 2:24:51 [10][11]. The top ten ran 1:09:14 to 1:16:47; 22.8% broke two hours and 56.7% broke 2:30 [10].

The 10 km is the biggest race, with 3,412 finishers (3,488 in 2024). It was won in 33:43 and the top ten were all inside 35:41, but the median was 1:18:55 and only 15.7% broke an hour, so it is very much a mass-participation race behind the leaders [10][11].

Women made up 16% of marathon finishers, 25% of half marathoners and 44% of the 10 km field [10]. A woman inside 3:30 would have been in the top ten in 2025, which makes this a realistic race to place in for a good club runner.

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: For 2027 the marathon assembles on Sanam Chai Road at 11pm on Saturday 9 January, for a 12.30am start; the half starts at 3am, the 10 km at 4.30am and the 5 km at 5am. The prize ceremony is at 7am and winners must attend to collect their awards [1].

The 2025 race was the 36th: the 2024 race was billed as the 35th [4] and the January 2027 race as the 37th [2]. Entry for 2027 costs THB 1,250 for the marathon, 950 for the half, 750 for the 10 km and 550 for the 5 km [2]. The organiser is the National Jogging Association of Thailand [3]; the 2024 race was run with Sports Center Entertainment and drew runners from more than 70 countries [4].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big-city marathon run through the night past the old palace district, with a mostly local field you can place in: a sub-2:45 man or a sub-3:30 woman was in the top ten in 2025. The 10 km and half are friendly to newcomers, with most of those fields finishing well behind the leaders.

Think twice if you need certainty. The race moved from its usual November slot: AIMS lists the 8 November 2026 date as postponed and the next race as Sunday 10 January 2027 [3]. Cut-offs, aid stations and the route map were not published when this was written, and a midnight start means a night without sleep.
Plan for heat anyway. The 2025 race had a dry, 25°C night, but in 2024 the dew point was 25°C before dawn [8][9]. A January date is new for this race, so check the forecast in race week.
This review draws on the organiser's 2027 race pages, the AIMS listing, earlier race coverage, airport weather records and the official results of the 2022 to 2025 races.

faqs.question: What time does the Bangkok Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Just after midnight. For the 10 January 2027 race the marathon starts at 12.30am on Sanam Chai Road, after an 11pm assembly, with the half marathon at 3am, the 10 km at 4.30am and the 5 km at 5am. The event closes at 8am. In 2025 the 10 km also started at 4.30am.

faqs.question: How hot is the Bangkok Marathon?
faqs.answer: It depends on the night. At the 12.30am start of the 2025 race, Don Mueang airport recorded 25°C with a dew point of 18°C, cooling to 23°C before dawn. A year earlier it was 28°C with a dew point of 23°C, rising to 25°C by 4am, and the 2024 marathon median was almost 26 minutes slower.

faqs.question: How long do most runners take at the Bangkok Marathon?
faqs.answer: In 2025 the median marathon finish was 4:52:14, with 18.7% under four hours and 55.5% under five; 90% finished inside 6:12:15. The median half marathon took 2:24:51 and the median 10 km 1:18:55. The top ten marathoners ran 2:21:35 to 2:43:34.

faqs.question: Is the Bangkok Marathon the same race as the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok?
faqs.answer: No. The Bangkok Marathon is run by the National Jogging Association of Thailand from Sanam Chai Road beside the Grand Palace; its 2025 race was on 16 November and the next is on 10 January 2027. The Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok is a separate race, held on 30 November in 2025 and starting from MBK Centre.

editorial_notes: Reinstated 2026-11-06: official results for the 16 November 2025 race (the 36th edition; the 2024 race was the 35th) are now on file, so the review is written about that race and attached to the 37th edition on 10 January 2027. The earlier withdrawal note said the 36th edition was held in January 2026; that was wrong, the results and AIMS show 16 November 2025, and AIMS lists the 8 November 2026 date as postponed to 10 January 2027 (no reason found). Finish-time figures are Run SEA's own analysis of the SportStats results for 2022 to 2025 (no times dropped as timing errors; 96 10 km finishers have no gender recorded and are left out of the women's share). Weather is from Don Mueang airport METAR observations, about 20 km from the start. No 2025 route map, aid-station plan, cut-offs or runner account could be found; start times quoted are the organiser's 2027 schedule, matching the 2025 10 km start. Runners are not named. No rating.
